systems.country_label: West African Police Information System; WAPIS Centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: Nigeria Police Force and Ministry of Police Affairs; ECOWAS programme funded by the EU and implemented by INTERPOL
systems.tiers: Centre at Force Headquarters, Abuja, inaugurated 26 May 2021; 20 workstations at sites of the police, immigration, NAPTIP and NDLEA

note: A police-affairs op-ed; local governments appear only in an appeal that they digitalise their systems and support police equipment. Nothing on local government offices or their connection.
